title: Qualify and advertise immiscible fluids
requires: Each driver that will advertise this profile
scope: Run public-API interface, conservation, lifecycle and stability gates before exposing immiscible records.
acceptance: Planar, droplet, shear, high-density-ratio, timestep, breakup-stress and long-run cases pass per advertising driver.
Capability evidence separates contact, pressure, interface and optional viscosity support and states parameter limits.
